subject: Horses
hook: HORSES IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Horses can live more than 60 years, far beyond the typical 25‑30‑year lifespan most people expect
angle_support: They reach full adult development by age five, and have an average lifespan of between 25 and 30 years.
The oldest verifiable record was "Old Billy", a 19th‑century horse that lived to the age of 62.
title: Horses Can Live Over 60 Years – The Truth About Their Lifespan
description: Most people assume horses only live 25 to 30 years. Rare cases like Old Billy prove they can reach 60 plus. Proper care can extend their lives dramatically.
narration: HORSES IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture a horse's life ending around twenty‑five to thirty years. In reality, a few outliers survive well past fifty, even reaching remarkably old record sixty years of age. Old Billy, a 19th‑century workhorse, lived to 62 years—the oldest verified horse. Modern Guinness‑listed pony Sugar Puff reached 56, showing horses can exceed the usual 25‑30‑year span. Good care can add decades to a horse's life significantly. So a horse can truly outlive three generations in your family
